official: 東京都高等学校等教育改革促進基金条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 提出議案と議決結果

name: 都立高校などの教育改革基金を新設
summary: 都立の高校などの教育改革に使う基金を新たに設けます。積立額は予算で決め、運用で得た収益も基金に入れます。条例は公布の日から施行し、令和11年3月31日で効力を失います。
changes: 教育改革に使う基金を設ける
積立額を予算で定める
運用で得た収益を基金に入れる
条例の失効時に基金の残額があれば国に納める
why: 都立の高校などで教育改革を進めるためと、都は説明しています。

en.name: Creates a fund for education reform at Tokyo metropolitan high schools and other schools
en.official: Tokyo Metropolitan High Schools and Other Educational Reform Promotion Fund Ordinance
en.summary: Creates a new fund for education reform at Tokyo metropolitan high schools and other schools. The amount set aside will be determined in the budget, and any earnings from managing the fund will also be added to it. The ordinance takes effect on the day it is promulgated and expires on March 31, 2029.
changes: Creates a fund for education reform
Sets the amount to be set aside in the budget
Adds earnings from managing the fund to the fund
Pays any remaining fund balance to the national government when the ordinance expires
en.why: The Tokyo Metropolitan Government says this is to advance education reform at Tokyo metropolitan high schools and other schools.
